key.name: equalizer-enabled
key.description: Whether the real-time PipeWire filter-chain equalizer backend is active.

key.name: active-preset
key.description: Identifier of the currently selected equalizer preset.

key.name: band-gains
key.description: Gain values in dB (-12.0 to +12.0) for 32Hz, 64Hz, 125Hz, 250Hz, 500Hz, 1kHz, 2kHz, 4kHz, 8kHz, and 16kHz.

key.name: bass-gain
key.description: Low-shelf biquad filter gain at 100Hz in dB (-12.0 to +12.0).

key.name: treble-gain
key.description: High-shelf biquad filter gain at 10kHz in dB (-12.0 to +12.0).

key.name: custom-presets
key.description: JSON object mapping custom preset IDs to their name, 10 band gains, bass gain, and treble gain.

key.name: preferred-player
key.description: The D-Bus name of the user's last selected MPRIS media player.

key.name: show-remaining-time
key.description: If true, displays remaining track time (-MM:SS); otherwise displays total track duration (MM:SS).

key.name: show-track-in-panel
key.summary: Show current track title in Top Bar
key.description: Whether to display the currently playing track title next to the Top Bar icon.

key.name: panel-position
key.description: Where to place the indicator on the GNOME Top Bar: left, center, or right.
